mechanism_narrative: Outdoor activity recovery leads indoor commercial recovery: PARKS has risen 30.9 points over three weeks, and continuation of that rise pulls people out of the home into mixed-use districts, lifting RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -55.9 to -25.0 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is at or below its last-28-day mean despite PARKS continuing to rise at least 5 points per week.

mechanism_narrative: Falling time at home is the binding constraint on discretionary trips. RESIDENTIAL has declined 3.4 points over three weeks; if it crosses below 20.0 within two weeks, home-exit frequency rises enough to lift RETAIL_REC above its trailing 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined monotonically from 23.4 to 20.0 over four weekly means
regime_hint: partial reopening with no new stay-at-home order
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL crosses below 20.0 and RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days does not exceed its prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Retail footfall requires both a destination pull and a movement channel: PARKS and TRANSIT rising together is a joint signal of restored trip-making. Only when both improve week-on-week does RETAIL_REC increase over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS and TRANSIT both improve week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT remains the most depressed series at -72.3, limiting trip generation
failure_condition: In weeks where PARKS and TRANSIT both improve week-on-week, RETAIL_REC still declines or is flat over the following 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Under an actively loosening restriction regime, transit-station reopening is the first-order gate on non-essential retail. Continued TRANSIT improvement from -76.9 toward -65 unlocks store visits and raises RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by more than 5 points relative to its t-3w level
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -76.9 to -72.3 over four weekly means
failure_condition: TRANSIT improves by more than 5 points versus t-3w yet RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days does not exceed the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Late-September cooling in this latitude ends the outdoor season: the PARKS surge decelerates and discretionary spending rotates indoors to retail and recreation, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks even as PARKS flattens.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly improvement falls below 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS weekly gains were 20.0, 1.2 and 9.7 points across the four-week window
failure_condition: PARKS decelerates below 5 points per week while RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days falls short of its prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Commuting return and home-absence reinforce each other: WORKPLACES improving while RESIDENTIAL falls means workers are out of the home on weekdays, generating lunchtime and after-work retail trips that lift RETAIL_REC within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises at least 2 points above its t-3w level while RESIDENTIAL falls below its t-3w level
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose 4.1 points and RESIDENTIAL fell 3.4 points over the window
failure_condition: The joint condition holds for two consecutive weeks and RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is still at or below its trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Grocery-and-pharmacy normalization is the leading edge of the household re-entry sequence: as GROCERY_PHARM climbs from -24.1 toward -15, households add non-essential errands to the same trips, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds -18.0 and RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days remains below its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT is the binding capacity constraint: with transit stations still 72 points below baseline, catchment reach for discretionary retail stays suppressed, so RETAIL_REC cannot clear its prior 28-day mean and drifts lower within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -65.0 for the entire week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has improved only 4.6 points in three weeks while remaining at -72.3
failure_condition: TRANSIT remains below -65.0 for the whole week yet RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days exceeds its trailing 28-day mean.
